### The Unity of God’s People under True Worship
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/unity-of-gods-people-under-true-worship
Passage: Joshua 22:29
Points:
- Returning across the Jordan, the eastern tribes built a large altar that sparked fears of illicit worship and rebellion among the western tribes.
- Israel's leaders confronted them out of commendable zeal to protect the purity of worship and prevent corporate judgment.
- The eastern tribes clarified that the replica altar was never intended for sacrifices, but as a witness confirming their rightful share in Yahweh.
- True unity among believers must be grounded in pure worship that strictly conforms to God's revealed truth.

### Bible Pathways - Mar. 21, 2008
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-mar-21-2008-11571301.html
Passage: Joshua 22:9-10
Points:
- Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh departed Shiloh and erected a prominent altar on the border by the Jordan.
- Settling outside the Promised Land created spiritual risks and misplaced priorities that threatened their connection to God's sanctuary.
- External physical memorials cannot achieve or preserve true fellowship among God's people.
- Genuine unity is an inward spiritual bond produced by the Holy Spirit and centered exclusively on Christ.
